entry.title: New: dsh-omni-vision
entry.summary: Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required. Exact install spec: github:renji004/dsh-omni-vision. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
